# HexPiece 3.8.6

Weapon categories, and the Saber's own more aggressive cuts. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all test suites pass; every
new sword animation passed the body check (no arm through the body, no blade through the head, every half tick) and was rendered
side by side with the katana's.

## Weapon categories
"Sort every Katana into the category of katana Gryphon into saber and yoru into yoru."
- Every blade now has a category: **every katana is a Katana, Gryphon is a Saber, Yoru is the Yoru** (Mace and Gun are ready for
  the weapons to come). The blade's tooltip now starts with its category.

## The Saber: more aggressive cuts (Gryphon)
"Saber Caterogy (Similar to Katanas but more aggresion, the idle and unsheath animation stay as it is (Gryphon))"
- Gryphon now swings its own versions of the sword cuts: the same moves, with the same timing and reach (they hit on the same
  ticks), but **driven harder**: the body twists further into each wind-up and each cut, hunches lower over it, lunges deeper and
  lower, and the head glares down the cut. 14 of the 16 cuts have a Saber version (the side cuts, the rising cut, the thrust, the
  reverse cuts, the plunge, the pivot cut, the advancing cut, both aerial cuts, the quick cut, the charge and its release, the clash
  recoil). The kesa and the overhead makko stay as the katana's for now (Gryphon's bigger hand guard brushed the body in them).
- **Gryphon's idle, guard, draw and sheathing are unchanged**, as asked.
- The Mace and the Gun (from your Blender files), and the clothes, come next.
